description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Viewdeletemodule' which extends 'SugarView' to handle the display logic for deleting a module in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It includes methods to get module title parameters and to display a confirmation message after deletion.

classes.name: Viewdeletemodule
classes.description: A view class for handling the deletion confirmation page in ModuleBuilder, extending SugarView and providing module title parameters and a display method to show a confirmation message.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module's title display, including translated module name and module title from the controller.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Creates an AjaxCompose object and adds a section indicating the module was deleted, then outputs the JavaScript for client-side execution.
